PrivateUser.title: PrivateUser
PrivateUser.description: Private user account record isolating PII such as email from other users.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID matching document ID.

carInfo.description: Driver vehicle description for parking handovers.

PublicProfile.title: PublicProfile
PublicProfile.description: Non-PII discoverable messenger and driver profile for starting chats, calls, and parking handovers.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID matching document ID.

carInfo.description: Vehicle color/model for recognizing driver at parking spot.

discoverable.description: Whether this profile appears in the messenger directory.

spotsShared.description: Total parking spots shared by the user.

spotsCaught.description: Total parking spots caught by the user.

Chat.title: Chat
Chat.description: Direct dialog, group chat, or district parking coordination channel.

creatorId.description: UID of user who created the chat.

inviteCode.description: Short alphanumeric code for joining group/parking channels.

joinable.description: True if signed-in users can join via invite code.

lastMessageText.description: Preview of the most recent message.

lastMessageSender.description: Display name of the last message sender.

ChatMessage.title: ChatMessage
ChatMessage.description: Individual message inside a chat, including optional shared parking spot reference.

senderId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the sender.

spotAddress.description: Optional parking address when sharing a spot.

memberUids.description: Denormalized member UIDs from parent chat for flat rule evaluation.

publicChannel.description: Denormalized joinable flag from parent chat.

CallSession.title: CallSession
CallSession.description: Real-time audio/video call signaling and call history record.

callerId.description: UID of the user initiating the call.

ParkingSpot.title: ParkingSpot
ParkingSpot.description: Live community parking spot available to catch or about to become free.

posterId.description: UID of driver reporting or releasing the spot.

posterCar.description: Vehicle description of the leaving driver.

address.description: Street address or landmark of the parking spot.

note.description: Helpful tip about entry, barrier, or size.

hasCoordinates.description: True when real GPS coordinates are attached.

leaveInMinutes.description: Minutes until driver vacates (0 if free right now).

publicFeed.description: Visible in the live community parking catcher feed.

claimedByUid.description: UID of driver who caught the spot, or empty string.

claimedByName.description: Display name of catching driver, or empty string.

claimedByCar.description: Vehicle description of catching driver, or empty string.

/users/{userId}.description: Owner-only private account profile isolating PII.

/public_profiles/{userId}.description: Public non-PII directory profiles for messenger contacts and driver identification.

/chats/{chatId}.description: Direct messages, group chats, and district parking channels.

/calls/{callId}.description: Voice and video call signaling and call history.

/parking_spots/{spotId}.description: Live community parking spots for catching free spaces.
